_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 9, Kindness Tests: Shop Owner 2 (a pita bakery in the Old City souk). V1. One camera: VID_..031 = POV 9:16. Arabic -> English captions. Shape: ASK -> the pita handed down -> reveal, the hand goes up -> the money waved away, both men laughing. Three shots, two cuts. NO ZOOMS: every beat is the full frame. Few captions on purpose: only lines two models agree on are drawn, and the faces carry the rest.
_left_out: 31.5-40s which bread (white or brown) - slows the ask. Tal's phone clips IMG_8318/8319 are a wide of the stall from across the lane with shoppers walking between camera and subject the whole time - not used.
beats: THE ASK at the bread stall, the baker leaning over his counter: "Sorry to bother you, brother. I'm hungry and I have nothing on me. Could I have a piece or something?"

THE YES SEEN, then REVEAL + REFUSAL in one take (14s): a pita comes down into his hand - "Honestly, we're doing a test" - the baker's hand goes up: "No!" - "A test of Arab generosity" - the man behind him starts laughing
PAYOFF, the money held out and waved away: "No, no, no" - both men laughing - "Bless your heart"
